extra_quotes: To construct the optimization problem, we generate synthetic multilayer Moir´e configurations by stacking six hexagonal mesh layers with independently controlled rotational angles.
The final dataset consists of 600,000 unique six-layer rotational configurations, forming a large discrete design space with high combinatorial complexity.
In this work, BO is driven by theqLog Expected Improvement (qLogEI) acquisition function, a batch variant of the Expected Improvement (EI) criterion, with 10 points sampled per iteration.

Among the models already implemented in FruBO, we evaluated CatBoost [24]. Since CatBoost does not inherently estimate predictive uncertainty, uncertainty was approximated using a query-by-committee strategy comprising five independently trained CatBoost models initialized with different random seeds.

In contrast, applying BO with the traditional Gaussian Process (GP) (specifically the baseline GP from GPyTorch [25]) surrogate proved impractical, as the steadily increasing memory consumption exhausted the available GPU resources after only 290 acquired samples (Fig. 3(e)).
